Overview

Judge agreement (Cohen's kappa, black line = trust bar)

Kappa measures how much two graders agree, after removing agreement that could happen by luck. 1.0 is perfect agreement, 0 is no better than chance, below 0 is worse than chance. The black line is the trust bar we set: a judge must clear it before its scores can stand in for human review.
